description: This PHP script handles the upload and validation of a language file within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes license headers, loads required dependencies, and performs checks to ensure uploaded files do not exceed PHP configuration limits. It verifies the file's existence and size, and terminates if limits are exceeded.

methods.name: getJSONobj
methods.description: Creates and returns a JSON object handler used for encoding and decoding JSON data.

methods.name: return_bytes
methods.description: Converts a size string (e.g., '2M') into its byte representation.

methods.name: sugar_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations needed before script termination, as defined by the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework.
